title: Member Appeals Program: Summary of Filing Terms by Package
content:
A member, or someone acting for the member, files an appeal under the Member Appeals Program on the terms below. Most terms are the same in all six Northbridge Appeals packages. Two terms differ between packages: whether a standard appeal may be made by phone, and how quickly the appeal is acknowledged.

## What may be appealed

Under every package, three kinds of denial may be appealed:

- a denied coverage review case;
- a denied formulary exception;
- a denied paper claim.

## Terms common to all six packages

| Term | Every package |
|---|---|
| Time to file a first-level appeal | 180 calendar days after the denial notice date, with the notice date counted as day zero |
| Urgent appeal by phone | Allowed |
| Urgent appeals taken around the clock | Yes |
| What makes an appeal urgent | The prescriber's attestation, or that of a physician with knowledge of the condition |
| Appeal filed by someone other than the member or the prescriber | Requires an appointment-of-representative form |
| Undecided appeals per denied record and level | Only one at a time |

## Terms that differ by package

| Package | Standard appeal by phone instead of in writing | Written acknowledgment within (business days after filing) |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Appeals Level One Delegated | Not allowed (written only) | 5 |
| Northbridge Appeals Two-Level Delegated | Not allowed (written only) | 5 |
| Northbridge Appeals Single-Level with External Review | Allowed | 3 |
| Northbridge Appeals Two-Level with External Review | Allowed | 3 |
| Northbridge Appeals State-Regulated Insured | Not allowed (written only) | 5 |
| Northbridge Appeals Full Fiduciary Delegation | Allowed | 3 |

## Examples (hypothetical)

- *Standard appeal by phone.* A member under Northbridge Appeals State-Regulated Insured wants to make a standard appeal by phone. That package does not allow it, so the standard appeal is made in writing. Under Northbridge Appeals Full Fiduciary Delegation the same standard appeal may be made by phone.
- *Urgent appeal by phone.* An urgent appeal may be made by phone under any of the six packages, at any hour, because urgent intake runs around the clock in every package.
- *Acknowledgment.* An appeal filed under Northbridge Appeals Two-Level with External Review is acknowledged in writing within 3 business days after filing. The same appeal filed under Northbridge Appeals Two-Level Delegated is acknowledged within 5 business days.
